blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA–Double Olympic champion gymnast Carlos Yulo said he was “overwhelmed” on Thursday after winning Asian Games floor gold in Japan to complete his collection of major titles. Yulo became the only multiple Olympic gold medal winner in Philippines history when he won the floor and the vault in Paris two years ago. The 4-feet-11 Yulo sealed his first Asian Games gold with a score of 14.666 to complete a clean sweep of Olympic, World, Asian and Southeast Asian Games titles. “Having this in my collection … it’s all complete […]...
